description.basis: existing geographic and literary sources associated with this place

texts.en: Nick’s evening walk passes the former Murray Hill Hotel, which stood on Park Avenue.
texts.it: La passeggiata serale di Nick passa presso il vecchio Murray Hill Hotel, che si trovava su Park Avenue.
texts.fr: La promenade du soir de Nick passe près de l’ancien Murray Hill Hotel, situé sur Park Avenue.
texts.es: El paseo nocturno de Nick pasa por el antiguo Murray Hill Hotel, que estaba en Park Avenue.
